description: This file defines the ScreenRecordService class responsible for recording the screen using ReplayKit. It manages capture configuration, handling video and audio samples, writing to a file, error handling, and session management. Includes internal classes, error enums, and utility functions related to screen recording.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Main class providing the screen recording functionality using ReplayKit, AVFoundation, and custom internal classes.

classes.name: UncheckedSendableBox
classes.description: A generic, internal struct used to wrap values for thread-safe passing across concurrency domains.

classes.name: CaptureState
classes.description: An internal class encapsulating the state during capture, including lock, writer, inputs, and error info.

classes.name: ScreenRecordError
classes.description: An enum representing possible errors during screen recording, conforming to LocalizedError with descriptive messages.

classes.name: RecordConfig
classes.description: A struct holding configuration parameters for a recording session, such as duration, fps, output URL, and audio inclusion.

methods.name: record
methods.description: High-level async method to start, monitor, and complete a screen recording, returning the output file path.

methods.name: makeRecordConfig
methods.description: Constructs a RecordConfig object based on optional parameters and validation.

methods.name: makeOutputURL
methods.description: Generates output URL based on user-specified path or a temporary filename.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Begins the Capture session asynchronously with completion/error handling.

methods.name: makeCaptureHandler
methods.description: Creates the closure for handling incoming sample buffers during capture, dispatching to appropriate processing.

methods.name: handleVideoSample
methods.description: Processes video CMSampleBuffer, manages buffer inclusion, and initializes writer if needed.

methods.name: prepareWriter
methods.description: Sets up the AVAssetWriter and its inputs based on the sample buffer, handling errors.

methods.name: handleAudioSample
methods.description: Processes audio CMSampleBuffer, appending to inputs if recording includeAudio.

methods.name: stopCapture
methods.description: Stops the ReplayKit capture session asynchronously.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Finalizes the AVAssetWriter session, flushing buffers and checking for errors.

methods.name: finishWriting
methods.description: Completes writing to the file asynchronously, handling errors.
